steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Come take a gander, feast your eyes on these fresh fruits and vegetables!

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Oi, old man, isn't that the lad from the Yek family? It's been a while since he's come by the market.

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: What'd you expect? The boy's a guard for the Master's clan now. When would he have time to come here?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Ah, long time no see, Uncle. How have you been?

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Oh my, it really is you, Matterhorn. Heh, so what brings you around these parts today?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I've had some spare time lately, so I thought it would be nice to cook dinner for the Master.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Good, good. Don't let your cooking skills go to waste. C'mere, go ahead and take this strip of steak. I remember the Master enjoyed them when he was young, and you'd always take a whole bag with you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Thank you for your kindness, but let's get five pounds of tenderloin first.

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Oh, and the youngest was just a little girl at the time. Whenever you'd go shopping, she'd follow right behind you, tugging at the hem of your clothes.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hahaha, Ensia was indeed quite small back then—also extremely curious, and she refused to stay indoors. She would make me bring her along.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Here, the tenderloin's good to go. Hmm, the Master's tastes have changed, eh? Didn't he used to prefer short ribs?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes, the Master... grew up.

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Matterhorn, about the older sister... Oh no, I mean, excuse this addled old geezer. How has the Saintess been? All of us... miss her a lot.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The Saintess... has been in good health. Everything is well.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Kjeragandr watches over her, so of course it is. You worry too much, old man.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: After all, the reason we can continue our humble little lives here is because the Saintess managed to stabilize the situation at a critical time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: She is as bright as the snow itself. If she was able to deal with that crisis so calmly, lesser problems would surely pose no issue to her.

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Good, good. Now all that's left is for her to be reunited with her siblings and old friends, and then we'll all live happily ever after. Hahaha!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (If only that were the case...)

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Ah, how much you've all grown in the blink of an eye. Time sure flies these days.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Hardly. They've all grown up, but we've grown old. The young don't appreciate what they have.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Don't say that, you shine just as brightly now as ever before.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Hahaha, spare me the flattery.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: What's with that frown on your face? Something on your mind?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Auntie... After some thought, I think I'd like some short ribs after all.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Alright, I'll have it right up.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Here you go, is this enough?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That'll be fine, thank you. This is enough money, yes? I'll put it on the table here.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Heh, you young folks sure can add things up fast.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Alright, you two. I need to start dinner preparations soon, so I'll be heading back now.

steps.name: Hawker B
steps.text: Good, good. Don't let us old folks keep you any longer.

steps.name: Hawker A
steps.text: Come visit us when you have the time!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: *exhales*...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (Huh... It's Matterhorn. What's he standing there like a statue for?)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Matterhorn!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's getting harder...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Matterhorn, what are you muttering about in the middle of the hallway with a plate in your hand?!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Oh, Lady Ensia!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Didn't you say you were going to go out to eat dinner with Aurora? You haven't left yet?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: It's not anytime soon, so there's no rush.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Whoa, what a feast! Do we have guests over tonight?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Not quite. The Master finally has time to come home for dinner, and I wasn't doing anything else, so I decided to go ahead and prepare a few dishes for him.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: That's a lot more than a few dishes. Let's see, let's see... Whoa, you even made my favorite braised pork!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I don't even want to eat out anymore. Maybe staying home and having dinner with my brother wouldn't be so bad...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Haha, then you're more than welcome to stay, Lady Ensia!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: What else would you like? I can always make a couple more dishes.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Oh no, I'm good. You're already going overboard! This is more than enough.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Alright then. It'll be a few more minutes, so don't wait for me. I still have some stew on the stove, so I'll bring that over later.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Okay, I'll go wash my hands then!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (If Ensia is here, then...)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (For now... How am I going to speak with the Master?)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia, I've brought the stew. First— Oh...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Good evening, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Weiss, why are you here? Is the Master not back yet?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Courier was just telling me that Enciodes is a bit busy, and probably won't make it back for dinner.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I hope you don't feel too bad, Lady Ensia. Some things came up at the last minute.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I see... Then why don't we wait a little bit longer, just in case he can make it later?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Matterhorn... Can I have a word with you?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Is this something you can't say in front of Lady Ensia?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I was thinking, it's probably best not to wait for him... You know how the Master is, once he gets busy he'll spare no time for anything else.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Mhm. I know, Weiss.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Matterhorn! Just a friendly word of advice, don't keep waiting...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Maybe saying that he'd be late... was already his way of being considerate to you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Weiss...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: For someone as thoughtful as you, a statement like that... should already have been clear enough.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Alright, I understand. By the way, I started smoking some jerky a few days ago. I'll go to the kitchen to pack some for you later. So you can take it with you as a snack.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: You... still haven't come to terms with reality yet.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: I appreciate your kindness, but my physician urged me to watch my diet because of a recent injury. And I thought I should take it to heart.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You're hurt, Weiss?! Where? What else did the physician say?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: It's just a little scratch. Nothing you need to worry about, my friend.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But why didn't you tell me? You're always hiding things from me these days. That's what has me worried the most.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Haha, ever since I was little, you've always been worried sick about me whenever I got hurt. But now that we're all grown up, it's just embarrassing to keep putting that on you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You're right... You can take care of yourself now.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: One more thing... It's about—

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Hold on, Weiss.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (*Searches around in his pocket*)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Are you looking for something?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Here, this is for you.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: These are... snowflake crisps?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I passed by the candy store this morning. When you were little, you'd beg me for these every single time you were hurt during training. I was afraid you'd ruin your teeth.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But look at you now, you don't even want my stuff anymore. Guess I haven't gotten used to it yet, haha.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Matterhorn...

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: (*Rips open the candy wrapper*)

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: You have any free time later on? After I recover... let's go for a drink at the tavern.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sounds good. Whenever you're up for it.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Anyway, I'd better get going. See you later.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Uncle Matterhorn, what did Courier say to you? Will my brother make it back tonight?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Go ahead and eat first, Lady Ensia. The Master might not be back until quite late.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I see, figures...

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Then you should join me at the table too. Food doesn't taste as good when you're eating alone.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Mm... Alright, Lady Ensia.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Let's have a bit of the stew first. The broth should be nice and rich from the bones.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: *sips*— Whoa, what a rich taste. Your cooking skills are truly amazing.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Haha. You're welcome to try these charbroiled short ribs next.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Whoaaa, these are delicious!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: There's no need to rush, Lady Ensia. Please be careful not to choke.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Huh? You should totally dig in too!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Haha, very well.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (Lady Ensia seems to have a great appetite today. I thought she hadn't been eating well recently because... Well, maybe I've been overthinking things.)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Whoa, those tendons came out so tender and chewy! Can I get another helping?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sure. I'll get it for you.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: I'll have another bowl of stew too. The meatballs are soaked in the flavor and taste super amazing.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia... You're still not full yet?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Not even close! Get me another bowl of mashed potatoes too!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You still have room for more? That's already your third bowl.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (She's eating way more food than she can handle...)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (*chewing*) Your cooking... ish way choo delishush!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (*struggles to swallow*)

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: (*covers mouth) Oh, crap!

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: *Hiccup*—!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia... If you're already full, it's fine to stop.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Y-yeah, maybe... I'm starting to feel a little full after all.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But, there's still so much left over... You spent so long making all this delicious food, I'd feel bad if it went to waste.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: And I'd feel bad if your stomach exploded from overeating.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Uncle Matterhorn...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: As long as you enjoy your meals with a smile on your face, that's enough for me.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: But, but, if my brother was here, then we'd be able to finish.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Are you frustrated that he couldn't make it?

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Well, yeah. We haven't sat down for a face-to-face dinner in forever! He always leaves in a rush in the morning and doesn't come home until late at night. I barely even get to see him.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Say, when I snuck up to see my sister and messed up his plans, that must've really made him mad, huh?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia... You didn't do anything wrong, and the Master... He wouldn't blame you for it either.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: If only there'd come a day when our whole family could gather at one table to eat and talk and laugh, all in front of your delicious cooking...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Don't lose heart, milady...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I'll always be here for you. If there's anything you want to eat, I'll make it for you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: No matter... No matter what happens in the future.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Mm... Uncle Matterhorn...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's getting late. You should get ready for bed soon.

steps.name: Cliffheart
steps.text: Mhm. You too.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: (*Tidies up the dishes left on the table*)

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: *exhales*... What should I do...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master, you've returned.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Matterhorn, were you waiting for me this whole time?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: I thought I sent Courier to convey that I wouldn't be able to make it back for dinner.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I kept worrying that you'd be too busy to eat, and what if you were hungry when you came back? So I decided to wait a bit longer.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Very well then. What do you have to eat?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Whatever you'd like, Sir. I'll make it for you right now.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: No need. Just heat something up, and that'll suffice.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Surely... that won't do. I only have leftovers.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Hm? Did Ensia not go out to eat today?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: When she heard that you'd be returning tonight, she decided to stay home.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: I see. I'll try to get back a bit earlier tomorrow.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Understood. As for tonight...

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: It's fine. I don't mind if it's just Ensia's leftovers.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...If you say so, Sir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Now go.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir, this is all that's left over from tonight's dinner.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: What a feast. You must've worked hard to make all this, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It is my job as your retainer.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: What happened to your hand?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I cut it earlier, when I accidentally broke a plate.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Go apply some medicine to it. It'll heal sooner that way.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I'll be sure to do that, Sir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Are these... charbroiled short ribs? I haven't had this dish in a long time.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Would you like some? I made them just like you used to love when you were younger. Nothing's changed at all.

As soon as those words left his lips, Matterhorn felt SilverAsh's eyes sweep across him back and forth. He suddenly panics, as if SilverAsh's torch-like gaze had penetrated through to what he had hidden within himself.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: That's alright. I'll just have a bowl of stew.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Right away, Sir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: (*takes a sip*) Very delicious. Your cooking is as spectacular as ever.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: As long as it suits your tastes, Sir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: You even prepared some braised beastmeat, which has always been one of Ensia's favorites. No wonder there isn't much left.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Lady Ensia... waited for you a long time this afternoon. She has been very uneasy, wondering if you blamed her for what happened back then.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: You've always paid particular attention to Ensia. But that's only natural, as she is the youngest of us.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir, I...

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: We can talk after I eat.
Inside the dining room, SilverAsh falls silent—only the soft sounds of chewing echo thorough the room. Matterhorn feels his throat twitch several times, but cannot produce even a single word.
Finally, SilverAsh sets down his cutlery and dabs the corners of his mouth with a napkin. Though his heart races, Matterhorn still lifts his head to look into SilverAsh's eyes.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: How long have you been cooking this stew?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: About a day.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: A whole day. Only you have the patience to wait that long.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir, you exaggerate. These things cannot be rushed. Do so, and you will spoil its flavor.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: What if you left it unattended over the flames and it boiled over?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: If you simmer it carefully, it will not boil over.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: True, but care alone is not enough to make the stew. When the time is right, you also have to snuff out the fire.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: That is indeed true, Sir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: In other words, Matterhorn—

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Have you thought it over?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir... Indeed, I have.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Then... From now on, you no longer have to follow my orders.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Do you want me to watch over Lady Ensia full-time?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Indeed, she needs your protection right now more than I do.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I am always ready to serve you at a moment's notice, should you need me.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: No, that won't be necessary. Not only must you watch over her full-time, you must do so with your full devotion.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I shall respect your wishes without hesitation. But I do not understand...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir... When did you make this decision?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: When did we first meet, Matterhorn?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: When you were still a baby.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: It's been that long, huh...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: The Yek family has served the clan for generations, and this is my duty as protector of your house.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Protector... Enya and Ensia both see you as family, you know. Do you still insist on calling yourself that?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I wouldn't dare overstep my bounds.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: There is nothing to fear. I am stating fact, not posing a question.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: All sorts of problems have been pressing down on us since my return from Victoria. I can see that you've endured your share of difficulties as well.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I apologize for causing you worry, but...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But your relationship with Enya and Ensia...

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Say no more. I feel much more at ease with you protecting the two of them.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir, your subordinate apologizes for being unable to help shoulder your burdens.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Matterhorn... no matter what happens, you must protect my sisters.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I will stand by their sides, even if it costs me my life.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: I'll hold you to that.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: But for now, leave me. I need to rest.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: Matterhorn—

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Did you need something?

steps.name: SilverAsh
steps.text: No, it's just... Thank you, for all these years... For being here.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Master...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Please get some rest. You've been working too hard.
